title: Fork graph on the BoatAttack test repo

pins.note: Stash drawn as its own node in the graph
Branches grouped by folder prefix (conflict/, feature/, hotfix/)
Quick Launch (Ctrl+P): fuzzy commands, repos, branches
Lanes coloured per branch; usable < 3 s after open

insight: Graph, sidebar and stash-as-node were ready before the first screenshot; nothing to wait for on a 1.8k-commit Unity repo.
gitgud: Claude's pick: show stashes as graph nodes and group branches by prefix folder.

title: Fork image diff of an LFS texture, side by side

pins.note: LFS badge on each side: Fork smudges the pointer to show pixels
Side-by-Side / Swipe / Onion Skin
Dimensions and byte size under each image

insight: Selecting a changed LFS PNG opens a real image diff straight away, no extra click.
gitgud: Claude's pick: steal the three image modes and the LFS badge; this is table stakes for game repos.

title: Fork image diff, Swipe mode

pins.note: Draggable swipe divider: old left, new right
Mode switch

insight: Swipe makes a hue shift obvious in one glance.

title: Fork interactive rebase dialog

pins.note: fixup! commit pre-set to Fixup and moved under its target (autosquash)
Per-row action: P/E/R/S/F/D keys, Ctrl+Up/Down to reorder
Update dependent branches
Backup current state with a temporary branch

insight: The whole rebase plan is edited up front, reword included; nothing pops an editor mid-rebase.
gitgud: Claude's pick: steal the todo-list dialog with autosquash pre-applied and the backup-branch checkbox.

title: Fork merge dialog predicting conflicts

pins.note: 'Merge will cause conflicts' shown before anything runs
Merge option: default / no-ff / squash

insight: Fork dry-runs the merge and warns before you commit to it; cherry-pick shows 'can be done without conflicts' the same way.
gitgud: Claude's pick: steal the pre-flight conflict prediction for merge, rebase and cherry-pick.

title: Fork built-in merge on a Unity prefab

pins.note: Tick a side to take it for every conflict
Resolved counter with prev/next
Editable result pane; prefab merged as plain YAML text

insight: Good text merger, but no UnityYAMLMerge: external tools list only Visual Studio and VS Code.
gitgud: Claude's pick: same 3-pane shape, plus UnityYAMLMerge detected and offered first for .prefab/.unity.

title: Sublime Merge working directory: image and text diffs in one scroll

pins.note: Side by side / Onion skin
LFS tag
Hover a hunk: Stage Hunk / Discard Hunk
Commit message box sits above the changes

insight: Every changed file is expanded inline; staging a hunk is one click on the hunk's own row.
gitgud: Claude's pick: steal inline per-hunk buttons that stay put; avoid Fork's far-right hover pill.

title: Sublime Merge command palette

pins.note: Each command shows the git command it runs
...and its shortcut

insight: The palette teaches git: 'Pop Stash' is labelled 'git stash pop'. Commands chain into flag pickers.
gitgud: Claude's pick: steal the git-equivalent column; it doubles as documentation.

title: Sublime Merge commit Edit menu (no rebase todo list)

pins.note: Edit message / contents, squash with parent, move up/down, drop
Fixup squash needs a multi-selection

insight: History edits are one commit at a time; squash with parent kept the 'fixup!' line in the message.
gitgud: Claude's pick: offer per-commit quick actions, but also the full todo-list with autosquash.

title: Sublime Merge merge dialog

pins.note: 'Runs git command git merge conflict/theirs'
Flags as checkboxes

insight: Shows exactly what will run; no conflict prediction.
gitgud: Claude's pick: steal the command preview, add Fork's prediction.

title: Sublime Merge mid-merge: conflicts inline

pins.note: 'failed' badge + raw git message as a toast
Resolve / Using Ours / Using Theirs per file
'Stage all unmerged files to continue': stages conflict markers as-is

insight: Conflict markers show inline in the normal diff; per-file resolve choices are one dropdown away.
gitgud: Claude's pick: steal per-file ours/theirs; avoid a one-click 'stage all unmerged'.

title: Sublime Merge 3-way merge tool

pins.note: Merged pane in the middle, Base/Merged toggle
Arrow per hunk: 'Use this hunk' (Ctrl+Shift+])
'all conflicts resolved'
Save and Stage

insight: Taking both sides is two arrow clicks; the header confirms when nothing is left.
gitgud: Claude's pick: steal the ours | merged | theirs layout with per-hunk arrows.

title: GitButler warns that LFS filters are skipped

pins.note: 'Filters will silently not be applied during workspace operations' + 185 LFS files
Workspace mode switches HEAD to gitbutler/workspace

insight: GitButler's virtual-branch workspace bypasses git-lfs; it says so honestly, but it is a blocker for Unity repos.
gitgud: Claude's pick: avoid any workspace model that bypasses smudge/clean filters.

title: GitButler diff of the LFS texture

pins.note: Pointer text only: oid and size

insight: No image diff at all for LFS files.

title: GitButler commit with hunk and line checkboxes

pins.note: Hunk checkbox (each line has one too)
Unticked hunk B stays out
File-level checkbox

insight: Selecting what goes into a commit is ticking boxes in the diff; no separate staging area.
gitgud: Claude's pick: steal checkbox selection as an alternative to stage/unstage.

title: GitButler refuses to apply a conflicting branch

pins.note: 'It conflicts with stack ht-branch-1. Unapply it first'
Applied stack lane

insight: Two branches touching the same lines can't be in the workspace together; there is no branch-into-branch merge.
gitgud: Claude's pick: avoid: merging is a core task.

title: GitButler squash by drag and drop

pins.note: Drop target labelled 'Squash'

insight: Drag a commit onto another to squash; the target says what will happen.
gitgud: Claude's pick: steal labelled drop targets for history edits.

title: GitButler after rewriting a pushed branch

pins.note: 'This branch and its remote have diverged'
Prominent 'Update local branch...' would pull the old commits back
Force push

insight: After a deliberate rewrite the loudest button undoes it.
gitgud: Claude's pick: avoid; after a rewrite, offer force-with-lease first.

title: GitButler operations history

pins.note: Revert itself is logged, so it can be reverted
Discard is a logged, revertible op
Manual snapshot

insight: Every operation, discards included, is a snapshot you can revert with one hover click. This recovered the discarded change; Fork and Sublime could not.
gitgud: Claude's pick: steal: an op log covering discards is the undo model gitgud wants.
